cmqwkgk5k07k3nwqob9a9xaxs.overview: Mechanical Engineering encompasses the design, analysis, and manufacturing of mechanical systems. This program is ideal for individuals seeking to deepen their knowledge in engineering principles and apply them to real-world challenges. Students engage in hands-on learning, research, and thesis work, preparing them for advanced roles in the industry.
cmqwkgk5k07k3nwqob9a9xaxs.entry: International applicants need at least a bachelor's degree; the programme commission decides on applicants whose degree is not in engineering. They are evaluated in the first stage on their bachelor's grade point average; the ALES minimum of 55 on the programme page is stated for Turkish applicants.
cmqwkgk5k07k3nwqob9a9xaxs.language: English-taught master's programmes need proof of English: the graduate regulation sets at least 60/100 in YDS or the university's English Proficiency Exam (İYS), or an equivalent score in an ÖSYM-recognised exam such as TOEFL, CPE or CAE (the Senate may set more). Graduates of English-medium universities in countries whose official language is English need no certificate. Newly enrolled students are also tested with the university's proficiency exam (pass mark 60/100).
documents: Bachelor's diploma or temporary graduation certificate
YÖK equivalence certificate (degrees from universities abroad)

cmqwkgk5k07kbnwqoldcbkvim.overview: The Mechatronics field combines mechanical engineering, electronics, computer science, and control engineering. cmqwkgk5k07kbnwqoldcbkvim.entry: You need a high-school diploma, or a document showing you are entitled to one, from a Turkish high school or from a school in Türkiye or abroad that the Ministry of National Education recognises as equivalent; the equivalence of a foreign diploma is processed as part of admission. International applicants are admitted under OSTİM Technical University's international student admission directive, whose principles are set by the University Senate, and the university may run its own selection for them (other students are placed centrally by ÖSYM on their YKS basic proficiency test (TYT) score). Registration becomes final once the university's registration conditions are met, including, for foreign nationals, that nothing prevents a student visa. The detailed application criteria for international applicants are set by the University Senate; ask the university's international office for the current ones.
